item.title: WordPress to Squarespace Migration
item.description:
250-750 USD | We are a Dubai-based luxury interiors and fit-out company moving our existing website to Squarespace, and we are looking for someone experienced to rebuild it for us.
This is a faithful rebuild, not a redesign. We want the same site we have now, recreated cleanly on Squarespace. We are not looking for new design ideas, new copy, or new images. Everything is provided and the current site is live for you to see exactly what to match.
Current site to copy: https://fdc-interiors.com
Scope: 18 pages in total.
• 6 main pages: Home, Our Story, Expertise, Portfolio, Media, Contact • 12 portfolio galleries (Cartier, Tiffany, Dior, Delvaux, Jimmy Choo, Vacheron, Piaget, Louis Vuitton, Chloe, Balmain, Burma, Special Projects) • A shared navigation menu and footer on every page, matching the current site
What you will receive from us:
• 129 images, the full-quality originals, already cleaned and numbered and grouped by page • An index spreadsheet showing exactly where each numbered image goes • All page text, which is on the live site to copy • A written one-page guidelines document • Editor (contributor) access to our Squarespace account
What we need you to do:
• Recreate all 18 pages on Squarespace to closely match the current layout, sections, structure and overall look • Make it mobile responsive, which Squarespace handles by default • Build the galleries as clean image galleries, photos only • Use the images and text we provide, placed as per our index
A few practical notes:
• The work is done entirely inside Squarespace. You will not need, and will not be given, any WordPress, hosting, or domain logins. • You will be added as a contributor to our account. We own the account. • We will handle connecting the domain ourselves at the end, so there is nothing sensitive for you to touch. • Please do not worry about SEO migration, e-commerce, or custom code. This is a straightforward brochure site.
Because the content is all supplied and the design is a direct copy, this is mostly careful assembly work rather than creative design, so it should be quick for someone who knows Squarespace well.
Please reply with:
• A fixed price for the complete job • Your delivery timeline • One or two examples of Squarespace sites you have built • Confirmation that you have read this and can start soon
Thank you, and I look forward to your quote.

item.title: Children’s Book Website Design & Development
item.description:
20-250 GBP | Website Designer/Developer Wanted – Interactive Children’s Author Website
Hi, I’m Lianne James, creator and author of Teddy’s Travels, a children’s picture-book series following Teddy, an apricot cockapoo, on different adventures.
I have already developed the overall look, artwork, characters, page ideas and much of the layout for the website. I am looking for someone who can take my existing designs and turn them into a professional, fully working, interactive website that works beautifully on both desktop and mobile.
What I already have
I already have:
My Teddy’s Travels branding and logo Character artwork for Teddy, Mabel and other characters Backgrounds and illustrations Designs/mock-ups showing how I would like many of the pages to look Buttons and other graphical elements Book covers Ideas for the structure and navigation My domain name: teddystravels.uk
I therefore don't need someone to create the whole concept from scratch. I need someone who can take what I have created and professionally build it into a working website.
The main website
I would like a colourful, welcoming homepage introducing Teddy’s Travels, with sections for parents and children.
The website should include information about the books, the author, Teddy and the other characters, along with links/buttons to purchase the books.
Interactive children's area
A very important part of the website is an interactive Explore Teddy’s World area.
Children should be able to choose one of Teddy's adventures, such as:
The Train Seaside Bluebell Woods Farmyard Big City Park London Zoo Starry Night
Each adventure will have its own themed area. I also already have the illistrations for these.
For example, the Seaside section could include:
Discover the Story
Seaside Fun, including activities such as:
Beach Treasure Hunt
Build a Sandcastle – ideally an interactive drag-and-drop activity where children can use different shapes/items to create their own sandcastle
Rock Pool Explore
Spot the Difference
Maze
Matching Shells
Fun Facts
Teddy's Journey, where children can explore different stops from the story, such as:
Cliff Tops
Beach Exploration
Rock Pools
Sandcastle Fun
Ice-Cream Stop
Harbour Boats
Sunset Views
Meet the Characters
Earn Your Badge
I would eventually like a similar structure for each of Teddy's adventures.
Rewards and badges
I would like children to be able to earn a different digital badge for completing activities/sections.
There should ideally be a My Rewards / See All My Badges area where children can see the badges they have collected across Teddy's different adventures.
I would like to discuss the best way of remembering a child's progress without requiring unnecessary personal information from children.
Sound and interaction
Where practical, I would like the website to feel playful and interactive, with things such as:
Button animations
Small character movements
Sound effects/chimes when an activity or badge is completed
Optional background music
A simple sound on/off control
I don't want the site to feel like a standard corporate website. It should feel like children are entering Teddy's world.
Mobile version
This is extremely important.
The website needs to be properly responsive, rather than simply shrinking the desktop version.
It should look and work well on:
Desktop computers
Tablets
Android phones
iPhones
Buttons and activities need to be easy for children to use on touchscreens.
If possible, I would also like the website to work well enough on mobile that it could eventually be developed into, or used like, a simple web app/PWA.
Parent/Grown-Ups area
I would also like a separate area for adults containing things such as:
About the author
About Teddy’s Travels
The book collection
Where to buy the books
New releases
Contact information
Email newsletter sign-up
Possibly downloadable activities/resources in the future
Book sales
I would like clear Buy the Book sections throughout the site.
Initially these may link to external retailers, but I would like the website built in a way that gives me the option of selling books or merchandise directly in the future.
Important requirements
I am looking for someone who:
Has experience creating responsive websites
Is comfortable building interactive elements, not just static pages
Can work from artwork and designs I provide
Can recreate my designs accurately
Understands mobile-first/responsive design
Can optimise images so the website remains fast
Can advise me on the best platform/technology for the project
Can make the website easy for me to update myself afterwards
Has experience with children's/family websites or interactive websites if possible
Understands the importance of privacy and safeguarding when creating online experiences aimed at children
What I would like from you
When replying, please let me know:
What platform/technology you would recommend for this project and why.
Whether you can build interactive activities such as drag-and-drop games, matching games, mazes and badge/reward systems.
Examples of similar interactive or children's websites you have built.
Whether the finished website would be easy for me to update myself.
Your estimated price.
What would be included in that price.
Your estimated timescale.
Whether ongoing support/maintenance is available and what that would cost.
I already have a strong idea of exactly how I want Teddy’s Travels to look and can provide my existing designs and artwork to the successful freelancer.
My aim is to create something that is more than an author website – I want children to be able to explore the stories, play, learn, collect badges and feel as though they have stepped into Teddy's adventures.

item.title: Mobile Subscription Site with Telegram Integration: Irish League Edge
item.description:
350-780 GBP | I’m bringing Irish League Edge (ILE) online and need someone to put every moving part in place for a seamless, mobile-first subscription business. The core of the project is subscription services and, above all, automated member access. Once a fan joins ILE+ and the payment processes, they should receive instant access to our private paid Telegram channel, while also keeping the open, free channel available to everyone. On expiry or cancellation, their paid-channel privileges must be revoked automatically—no manual workarounds.
Here’s the full picture of what I expect you to deliver:
• Mobile-optimised website built from the ground up, ready for high traffic. • Secure, recurring payment flow (monthly and annual plans) that talks directly to Telegram to grant or remove access without delay. • Dual Telegram setup: public free channel plus invitation-only paid channel, both managed through the site’s back-end. • Self-serve customer dashboard so subscribers can upgrade, downgrade, pause or cancel at will. • Complete hosting and domain configuration, SSL, basic hardening and ongoing analytics so I can track growth and churn. • Admin panel with role permissions, content management and detailed subscription reporting. • Automated emails/notifications for sign-up, renewal, failed payment and cancellation events. • End-to-end testing, security checks and clear hand-off of all source code and documentation.
I’m happy to hear your preferred tech stack—whether you lean toward WordPress + Woo/Stripe plugins, a Laravel build, or a JAMstack approach—as long as it meets the requirements above, is future-proof and easy for a non-technical editor to operate.
Acceptance criteria: 1. A new user can subscribe, pay, and see themselves added to the paid Telegram channel in under two minutes. 2. Cancelling or an expired card removes them from that channel within five minutes. 3. Admin area shows real-time subscriber counts and revenue. 4. Site scores 90+ on Google Lighthouse mobile performance. 5. All credentials, repos and walkthrough docs are transferred before final sign-off.
If this sounds straightforward to you and you have past examples of similar payment-to-Telegram automations, let’s talk timelines and milestones.
